$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/threads.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context: the email steps) writes threads and messages through apps/factory-api's platform/threads, always through command(). The partner role reads only what is shared with its party: a thread whose record is its party's, and the messages shared with it (Message.partyId is set exactly when the message's audience is PARTNER, so an internal note never matches a party). W2b (B-W2b-156, COL-060): a portal session also posts in its own party's record threads: a Message INBOUND, audience PARTNER, channel PORTAL, author PARTY with the person's name, attaching only files of the record shared with its party (the W0 rule), never an author id, a mention or a floor note (no column grant; the …_portal_frame_w2b_guards trigger holds the rest). The floor's role reads neither: a tablet is served a work order's notes marked forFloor by the API, in the tenant's system view after the floor's checks (B-W2b-71, B-W2b-F5). Message is an append-only ledger: no role updates or deletes it, and the triggers of the …_threads_guards migration refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login; a thread is never deleted either. TH-2 (threads plan, schema wave 4/9, B-TH-023): a thread names who answers it (ownerId, an office person; hidden from the partner role: the portal shows no owner), and ThreadRead keeps each person's own read mark per thread (the last message read): the office writes an office person's, and moves or removes it (Mark unread; the erasure of a person removes theirs: the …_threads_reads_th_guards trigger on ErasureRecord); a portal session reads and writes its own party's people's marks (partyId, the thread's party; the API keeps each person to their own: no 'seen by' list), on messages shared with its party only; the floor's role reads none (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4: no read record of a floor worker). A read mark is the person's own data (purpose: their account; no `personal` entry: the purposes of src/ownership.ts are the workers', and the person reads their own mark), named in the privacy notice. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`. TH-3 (threads plan, schema wave 5/9, B-TH-038; PR-03): a message may carry a typed amount and its currency (price grain; only on an office note that is not for the floor, the guard), hidden from the partner role, which neither reads nor writes them (the floor's role reads no message at all); the message it answers or corrects (same thread; a shared message points only at a shared one), which the partner reads and, in its own posts, writes; and `held`, true while its mail waits in the undo window or for good once taken back: the partner role reads and writes only messages that are not held (onlyValues), so a customer never sees a mail that was taken back. Message stays append-only for every runtime role (no UPDATE grant); the database itself clears `held` once when the mail leaves its window (…_threads_composer_th_guards).

Thread.about: The office makes a record's thread with its first message, keeps its last-activity time and closes or reopens it. A portal or link session reads the threads of its party's records (the API also needs the link's own record for a link); it never sees the reply token, the last-activity time (internal notes move it) or who opened the thread. TH-2 (B-TH-023): the office names who answers it (ownerId); a portal or link session never sees it.

Message.about: The office writes internal notes (and, in the email steps, the mail sent and received); it reads every message of the tenant (the API scopes it by the thread's company and site). A portal or link session reads only the messages shared with its party, never who in the office wrote them (it has the author's name), whom a note mentioned, or whether a note went to the floor. W2b: a portal session posts in its party's record threads (INBOUND, PARTNER, PORTAL, PARTY; the guard), with the same columns hidden, so a post has no author id, no mention and no floor note. TH-3 (B-TH-038): the amount and its currency are hidden from a portal or link session (the API shows them only with the price grain); a portal or link session reads and posts only messages that are not held (a mail waiting in its undo window or taken back stays the office's).

ThreadRead.about: TH-2 (B-TH-023): one person's read mark on one thread (the last message they read, and when). The office writes and moves an office person's own (opening the thread, Mark read / unread), removes one (Mark unread on a whole thread; a person's erasure removes theirs), and reads the person's own for the new-message counts (the API: never another person's). A portal session reads and writes the marks of its own party's people (the row's party, the thread's own) on messages shared with its party, so its counts hold only what is shared with it; it removes none. The floor reads none: no read record of a floor worker (Statuto dei Lavoratori art. 4).
